prompt: Someone running from a monster while a voice tells them where to go; they hide, then have to run again. Built to exercise sample definitions and a shared sample pack with break points.

requests.ask: make sharable samples from the voice recordings and a scary chase song that uses them

changes.why: voice: 8 phrase sounds, each trimmed in pack.json to the shouted words so bars 1 at cps .5 drops the line on the downbeat at its recorded speed; back-chop and out-chop add break points between the words for the climax

requests.ask: the sounds are slowed way down... is that an issue with how we do things

changes.why: pack bars 1>0.5 -- the takes are stereo and about 1.0 s of speech, which is half a bar at this tempo, not a whole one; the first pass sized every region against a file duration read as mono, so every line played at exactly half speed. Voice patterns doubled their rest counts to keep their placement, and the climax chops dropped stretch so the words stay words.

requests.ask: 9 pinned notes: alley/chase directions too repetitive, more immediacy at chase bar 14, nothing said twice in hide, run melody too happy and too common, run drums too spatish, make bar 14 of run feel like they should run, found should not repeat and should feel defeated

changes.why: one sound per part means variety is extra parts. alley 4 turns on 3 words, chase on co-prime periods 7/5/11 half-bars so the order never repeats and all three land on bar 14, hide 3 warnings one each, found says hes here then go back then stops
glockenspiel>vibraphone_bowed, notes rising 7-10-12 > falling 7-6-5-4-2, register .35: the old line was the bright motif used in other songs here

riser removed - the reverbed noise sweep over bars 12-16 was the spacious wash, and a riser inside the drop is the cliche. urgency now comes from the chops closing up (bars 0,2,4,6,9,11,12,13,14,15,15.5). run.drums.brightness .6>.42 closes the hats 20000>11950 Hz
progression i i VI i > i VII VI v so it sinks instead of resolving, drums level .5>.35, a low bass drone added; section rms 0.029 against runs 0.33

requests.ask: no.. less spastic (the run drums, not spacious)

changes.why: -- past .6 the hats choke and release falls to 0.02-0.05 s, so every hit clicked and cut the one before it; rendered decay tail 0.041>0.115
-- under .85 drops the clap, so four voices carry it instead of five; 36>26 onsets per cycle. chase.drums.articulation .6>.55 to get it off the same choke threshold
-- .08 was under bd's own .1 threshold so the section had no drums at all; .12 leaves a bare kick

requests.ask: 'go right' is hard, louder and harder than left, so it should be used differently. change pad sound on run and maybe elsewhere to harp

changes.why: takes are not interchangeable: 18 dB between softest and loudest in the pack. right:1 is +7.9 dB over left:0 and was on the most frequent period (6 calls a section); it is now a single call at chase bar 14, shouted over left and forward as they converge. alley uses right:0 (-2.1 dB) instead, nothing being urgent yet

here:0>here:1 -- here:0 is the quietest take in the pack (-6.2 dB) and it was carrying the reveal. take 2 delivers the line, level .5 keeps it in a defeated mix. the take picks the performance, level places it
psaltery_bow>harp with arp down; plucked it renders 2.8 dB under the bowed pad, so level 1.4 puts it back at parity (rms .0191 vs .0190)

requests.ask: choose a new key for the song. i want scary, not upbeat

changes.why: C:minor>E:phrygian. minor was not the problem -- the progressions were: run's i VI III WII in C minor is Cm Ab Eb Bb, and Ab-Eb-Bb is IV-I-V in the relative major, so the climax was reading as a bright pop cadence

rewritten off the bright degrees (III, VI) and onto the phrygian b2 and the diminished v: alley i i II i (Em Em F Em), chase i II i v (Em F Em Bdim), run i II iv v (Em F Am Bdim), found i i vii v (Em Em Dm Bdim). hide stays a static Em drone. the only major chord left anywhere is the bII
the third up did not brighten the mix: rendered run centroid 2016>2033 Hz, highRatio .217>.218 -- the change is harmonic, not spectral
